uzo.purpose: Narrows a list: the filters in one row that wraps, an action to reset them and the count of hits heard as it changes — binding the filters to the address stays the application's.

instead.kialo: What is filled and then sent once is a formularo, because a filter applies as it changes and sends nothing.

boundary.kialo: Filters a person saves and names are data of the application, because they live beyond the page; a person decides where they stand.

containers.name: page
containers.kialo: A filter bar stands above the list it narrows in a section of a pagxo, because the person reads the filters before the rows.

with.kialo: A filter of one value among many is an elektilo, its empty label the choice of all.
A search in the list is a kampo of kind search, because it filters by text.
Resetting the filters is a butono of low emphasis, because it is no primary action.
